programs.title: Edge Training
programs.desc: An advanced training experience designed to elevate your game through elite soccer training, tactical insight, film review, and performance development—all in one focused session built to help players become stronger, smarter, and more game-ready.

details.tagline: Where Training Meets Your Next Level.
details.body:
High-impact, specialized training designed for U13-U19 players who are committed to reaching the next level. The EDGE Program combines elite soccer development, tactical insight, film review, and performance training to help dedicated players become stronger, smarter, and truly game-ready.

## What to Expect 

- Elite technical skill development
- Game-based decision-making and soccer IQ
- Film review and tactical analysis
- Speed, agility, strength, and conditioning
- Performance-focused training designed to elevate on-field play

programs.title: Advanced Ball Mastery & Technical Development
programs.desc: An opportunity to sharpen skills outside of regular team training, with a focus on ball control, footskills, and 1v1s through a mix of fun and challenging activities.

details.body:
An advanced technical program for players looking to get additional touches outside of team training and sharpen the technical details that translate directly to game performance.

## What We Train

- High-repetition technical patterns 
- 1v1 Attacking & Change of Direction 
- Receiving & Ball Control
- Game-Speed Dribbling
- Creativity & Technical Execution

programs.title: Pro Development Program
programs.desc: High-level, fast-paced training directed by Omid Namazi - technical mastery, tactical themes, and game-realistic reps in a professional environment.

details.tagline: Train Like a Pro. Think Like a Pro. Become Your Best.
details.bannerPlaceholder: Drop a banner photo - Coach Omid / pro training session
details.body:
Join us this summer to train with one of the most experienced and respected coaches in the game through the Pro Development Program, personally directed and conducted by Omid Namazi - a US Soccer Pro License holder with experience at the professional, national team, and elite youth levels.

## Coaching Pedigree

Coach Namazi brings a wealth of high-level coaching experience, including serving as:

- Current Head Coach of DC Power FC
- Former coach with Hartford Athletic
- Former coach with Houston Dynamo
- Former US Youth National Team coach
- Former assistant coach for the Iran national football team
- Former Head Coach of Chicago Stars FC

This 8-week development clinic is designed to help players improve technically, tactically, and mentally in a high-energy professional training environment.

programs.title: Thanksgiving Break - Skills Camp
programs.desc: Make the most of the Thanksgiving break with extra training, technical work, and competitive play designed to keep players sharp while they enjoy time away from their regular team schedule.
meta: Individual Day Sign-Up or Full Camp

details.bannerPlaceholder: Fuel Your Game This Thanksgiving Break
details.body:
Thanksgiving break is a chance to get back to the details of the game. Players will work through technical training, individual skill work, and competitive activities designed to build quality repetitions and keep their game sharp between regular team sessions.

## What to Expect 

- Sharpening key technical skills
- Small-sided and activities that challenge players
- Quick passing, movement, and play in tight spaces
- Groups organized by age to create a competitive environment

programs.title: Elite Performance Academy
programs.desc: Professional-level training led by Eric Otero — combining technical development, speed and strength, soccer IQ, injury prevention, and performance training to build complete athletes.

details.tagline: Train Like a Professional. Perform Like a Champion.
details.body:
Professional-level athlete development led by Eric Otero (MLS NEXT HG Coach | Former Pro) — combining speed, strength, power, technical training, soccer-specific conditioning, and injury prevention with regular performance testing to maximize long-term development.

## Specifics 

- Elite Adult Performance: 5-6 AM
- Speed & Performance Training: 6-7 AM
- Elite Player Performance: 7-8 AM
- Recovery & Mobility Training: 12-1 PM
- After School Youth Performance Training: 3:30-5 PM

Membership options are available, with each class designed around a specific performance focus and athlete development goals.

programs.title: Little Boots
programs.desc: First touches, big smiles. A playful introduction to the ball that builds coordination and a love of the game.

details.tagline: Their First Touch. Their First Love.
details.body:
The perfect first soccer experience for your youngest player. Little Boots is built around play, movement, and fun.

## What to Expect

- Ball familiarity and basic motor skills
- Age-appropriate games and activities
- Positive coaching in a fun environment
- Building confidence through movement

programs.title: Fairfax County NO/OFF School Day
programs.desc: A full day of soccer featuring technical training, small-sided games, competitions, and fun activities designed to keep players active and developing when school is out.

details.body:
A structured day of training built around skill development, game play, and competition, giving players a chance to stay sharp and continue developing on their days off from school.

## Camp Schedules

- September 21, 2026 – Student Holiday
- October 12, 2026 – School Planning Day
- November 2, 2026 – Teacher Workday
- November 3, 2026 – Election Day / School Planning Day

## Who Is This For?

Players of all levels from U8 through U15. Groups are organized by age and ability to maximize the training environment.

programs.title: Pre-Travel
programs.desc: The bridge to competitive play. Build the foundation, confidence, and habits to step into travel soccer ready.

details.body:
The ideal stepping stone for players ready to make the transition from recreational to competitive soccer.

## Key Focus Areas

- Technical foundation - first touch, passing, dribbling
- Introduction to team shape and positioning
- Competitive mindset development
- Small-sided game application

programs.title: Midfield Mastery & Sports Performance
programs.desc: Designed for players looking to improve their effectiveness in possession and movement. Combines technical development with performance training.

details.body:
This dynamic training program blends technical development and athletic performance training, helping players improve their first touch, decision-making, passing, and movement at game speed.

## Why Midfield Mastery?

- Develops first touch, ball control, and decision-making under pressure
- Improves passing, combination play, and overall awareness in possession
- Enhances speed, agility, coordination, and change of direction
- Builds balance, body control, reaction speed, and explosiveness
- Helps players execute technical skills more effectively at game speed

programs.title: Command the Box (w/ USNT GK Coach)
programs.desc: Elite goalkeeper training covering shot-stopping, positioning, distribution, and game scenarios-led by DC Power US National team coach Brian.

details.tagline: Elite Hands. Elite Feet. Elite Mind.
details.body:
Position-specific goalkeeper training led by Brian Permian, a former NCAA Division I coach, former U.S. Youth National Team Goalkeeper Coach, and professional coach with three years of experience. Designed for goalkeepers who are committed to mastering their craft and reaching the next level.

## Technical Curriculum

- Shot-stopping mechanics and footwork
- Positioning and angles
- High ball and cross handling
- Game scenario decision-making
- 1v1 defending

programs.title: Shooting & Finishing Clinic + Performance Training
programs.desc: Build strength, speed, and power while sharpening finishing, movement, and confidence in front of goal.

details.tagline: Sharpen Skills. Build Strength. Score More
details.body:
Strength and confidence change games. This program combines athletic performance training with elite finishing development to help players become stronger, faster, and more dangerous in front of goal.

## What You Will Work On

- Creativity and decision-making in front of goal
- Off-ball movement and attacking runs
- Composure and technique under pressure
- Game realistic finishing repetitions and goal-scoring scenarios
- Strength, speed, power, endurance, and mobility

programs.title: Building 1v1 Confidence & Speed Training
programs.desc: Beat your defender, own the moment. Develop the moves, speed, and bravery to take players on and win.

details.body:
The ability to beat a defender in a 1v1 is one of the most valuable skills in soccer. This clinic is entirely dedicated to that art.

## Training Focus

- Explosive first step and change of direction
- Dribbling moves - cuts, step-overs, feints
- Body shape and deception
- Confidence under pressure
- Game-realistic 1v1 scenarios

programs.title: First Touch & Passing
programs.desc: Clean control and sharp distribution. Refine the two touches every great player relies on, every single game.

details.body:
Everything in soccer starts with your first touch. This clinic builds the technical foundation that sets elite players apart.

## Technical Curriculum

- Clean first touch in all directions
- Short and medium range passing
- Combination play and wall passes
- Speed of play under pressure
- Receiving with body turned

programs.title: Future Ballers
programs.desc: Master essential skills like dribbling, passing, ball mastery, and 1v1 moves through fun activities and small-sided games.

details.tagline: Master the ball. Own the game.
details.body:
The perfect environment for young players to build confidence on the ball. Future Ballers is built around creativity, technical skill, and fun.

## What to Expect

- Ball mastery and 1v1 creativity
- Engaging, age-appropriate skills and games
- Development of coordination and balance
- Building confidence through ball possession
